title.zh: 【Paradigm：币安被盗消息公开前已有大额比特币看跌期权成交】
title.en: 【Paradigm：币安被盗消息公开前已有大额比特币看跌期权成交】

current_state.zh: Paradigm says large Bitcoin put option block trades, including about $20M notional just 15 minutes after Binance wallet outflows began, were executed before news of the Binance breach was public, with roughly $590M in related options volume over the next eight hours.
